headlines: Chinese premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Traditional Medicine Congress and delivered remarks, Xinhua reported.
NBU Governor Pyshnyi said Russia’s unwarranted aggression must stop.
Ukraine's central bank governor Pishni said many delegates walked out during Russia's speech, calling it a deep and moving moment.

Explosion at chemical plant in Gujarat state kills at least five 【Explosion at chemical plant in Gujarat state kills at least five】A chemical plant in Gujarat state in western India exploded late on the 16th (local time). Local officials said on the 17th the blast killed at least five workers and injured five others, who were taken to hospital.

Gold may face further pressure through year-end, Capital Economics cites Fed hikes and AI outlook 【Gold may face further pressure through year-end, Capital Economics cites Fed hikes and AI outlook】Capital Economics climate and commodities economist Hamad Hussain said on Oct. 16 that gold could gradually weaken through the rest of the year, citing two factors: continued Fed rate hikes and the view that market worries about an end to the AI boom will ultimately prove temporary. TD Securities global head of commodities strategy Bart Melek said gold remains range-bound and is biased toward the lower end of its range amid substantial uncertainty over the Fed's next move.

China's Premier Li arrives in Tashkent to begin official visit to Uzbekistan 【China's Premier Li arrives in Tashkent to begin official visit to Uzbekistan】China's Premier Li arrived in Tashkent on the morning of Oct. 17 to begin an official visit to Uzbekistan at the invitation of Uzbek Prime Minister Aripov. He departed Beijing with State Councilor and State Council Secretary-General Wu Zhenglong among those accompanying him.
